_comment: Combat on the cover scenario: both duos armed, no race point, no looting to speak of. Every key is spelled out because --reward-json merges onto RewardConfig defaults, not onto this file: omitting a key silently restores the v0 value (alive_per_step 0.01, hp_delta 0.01, death -1.0, team_win 1.0). cover_bonus pays for breaking an armed enemy's line while the gun is empty and charges for staying in it; it is small on purpose and only works next to damage_dealt, or the policy learns that hiding is free. team_mix is partial: enough to make the pair fight together, not so much that credit disappears.
